**Look at [src/auth/refresh.js:15](src/auth/refresh.js:15).**

The 400 carries `invalid_grant`. That is not in `RECOVERABLE`. So `refreshToken` returns `undefined` instead of throwing. `session.js:8` then hands `undefined` to `decode`, which calls `.split`. The trace blames `tokens.js:6` because that is where it dies.

`tokens.js` and `session.js` are fine. The bad swallow is the `return undefined` on line 15.
